_meta.about: Which sites have wrapped or branded stalls, and the proof. kind art = custom artwork wrap, brand = the host's own logo or livery on the stall. A site is listed only when one of our real photos, one of our article cover images, or the article text shows or says it. Audited 2026-11-13 against all 39 wall photos and all 38 EVwire articles.

evidence_types.cover: the og:image of the linked EVwire article, saved in public/stories
evidence_types.article: quote from the article text on evwire.com

unverified.name: Statesville NC (Roam Energy) / Prattville AL (Lakh Enterprises)
unverified.why: The cover of the Roam article (27) shows a stall with a ROAM logo, but it does not say which of the two sites it is, so neither is marked.

unverified.name: Redmond, WA (Resound Energy)
unverified.why: Photos 149-154 show plain white stalls and the cover has a small Resound watermark that I could not confirm as stall branding.

unverified.name: Pie Safe Bakery, Deary ID
unverified.why: Articles 1, 2 and 3 list it next to the wrapped Suncoast stalls but never say its stalls are wrapped.

unverified.name: Grand Island, NE (PPR)
unverified.why: Photos 70 and 72 show plain white stalls; only the van is branded.

unverified.name: United Chargers Network
unverified.why: Covers of articles 23 and 24 show UCN-branded stalls, but UCN is not one of our mapped sites.
